FurtherAI now handles agency intake by voice and email. When a client calls the agency or emails the service inbox, FurtherAI picks it up, understands the request, finds the account, and carries the work through to completion. Your team approves wherever it's needed.

A lot of an account manager's day goes to requests that arrive one at a time: a certificate for a new contract, a question about coverage, a change to a policy. Each one comes in by phone or email, and each one starts the same way. Someone has to work out what the client needs, find the right account, pull the right documents, and log the work in the agency management system.

The work isn't hard, but it's constant, and it competes with renewals and new business for the same people. When volume spikes, requests wait, and clients notice. A certificate that arrives late can hold up a client's contract or their access to a job site.

Covering both channels matters. Plenty of clients still pick up the phone when they need something quickly, especially a certificate with a deadline attached. Others email the shared service inbox, where requests can sit behind newer messages. With voice and email intake, requests reach the same workflow however they arrive.

Insurance is a trillion-dollar industry that still runs on PDFs and Excel. It’s not the employees’ fault–the tools they use were primarily built at the dawn of the digital age, or worse yet, were never digitized at all. The work itself is complex, heavily regulated, and must be strictly accurate.

On the surface, this looks like the perfect opportunity for software automation. In practice, replacing core systems of record at scale is costly and risky when the stakes are this high. And so every year, carriers, MGAs, wholesalers, agents, and brokers instead choose to instead throw more humans at the problem, which in turn creates more internal complexity and a massive outsourcing ecosystem.

FurtherAI has developed flexible AI primitives that allow carriers, MGAs, and brokers to automate paper-based workflows. Its insurance-native workspace lets customers skip long implementation cycles and realize value from AI fast.

If you’re a carrier, broker, agent, MGA, or wholesaler, give the FurtherAI suite a try to see how AI could transform your business. And if you’re an employee looking to join a rocket ship bringing AI to insurance–they’re hiring.
